title: Local quantitative Eshelby stability assembled
text: The current study develops a manuscript-stage nonlinear two-sided local stability result near general nondegenerate ellipsoids in the stated homogeneous-isotropic dilatational setting.

title: Finite-width localization theory sharpens the post-instability question
text: Recent nonlinear and strain-gradient theories show that finite shear-band widths can be selected in important model classes, moving the open core toward the physical law governing post-localization evolution.

title: High-speed hydrogel experiments expose another dynamic-fracture regime
text: Recent experiments show strongly material- and rate-dependent crack speeds and branching, reinforcing that attainable speed and first instability are branch-selection problems rather than one universal limit.

title: Defect geometry shown to switch cylindrical-shell bifurcations
text: Recent continuation calculations show that small changes in imperfection geometry can reorganize the localized stability landscape and change collapse thresholds non-monotonically.

title: LPBF solidification-crack dynamics resolved at sub-millisecond scale
text: High-speed synchrotron imaging directly measures initiation and propagation during solidification, making propagation-law tests increasingly observable rather than post-mortem.

title: Scale-dependent dislocation closure becomes explicit
text: Recent continuum-dislocation and network-statistics studies show that the appropriate state representation can depend on observation scale and that additional network variables may be required for closure.

title: Scale, environment and disorder reshape hierarchical fracture mechanisms
text: Recent work shows that hydration, structural scale and microstructural randomness can change the active dissipation zone and fracture mode in hierarchical biological and nacreous materials.

title: Lavrentiev gap separates regular and relaxed finite-elastic states
text: A 3D neo-Hookean construction shows that the weak closure can achieve strictly lower energy through a dipole-type singular mechanism, making physical admissibility of singular states unavoidable.

title: Continuous and jumping Coulomb-contact evolutions separated in 2D
text: A sharp 2D result identifies conditions for absolutely continuous quasistatic evolution and constructs spontaneous jumps outside that regime, sharpening the remaining 3D problem.

title: Stochastic homogenization extended for brittle surface functionals
text: Recent rigorous work proves almost-sure homogenization for additional fracture-type surface energies, while strength, initiation and unrestricted crack evolution remain a distinct stochastic frontier.

title: Cross-level fracture synergy becomes quantitatively modeled
text: A hierarchical nacre model explicitly couples microstructural crack bridging to macroscopic stress and morphology, while broader reviews consolidate hierarchy, interfaces and scale as recurring toughening ingredients.

title: Griffith evolution homogenized in a periodic laminate
text: A rigorous special case shows that crack evolution can homogenize when the geometry and crack path are sufficiently structured, clarifying what remains difficult for random unrestricted fracture.
